snippet.title: How to do Lakshmi Pujan for Diwali? 🪔
snippet.description:
🪷 Diwali Lakshmi Puja | A Simple Step-by-Step Guide 🪔
By The Sadhana Movement 

1. Set Up Your Altar

Clean your Puja space and place the Murtis or images of Shri Ganesha, Maa Lakshmi, and Maa Saraswati.

Keep flowers, a diya, dhoop, kumkum, akshata (unbroken rice), sweets, fruits, and other offerings ready.

2. Prepare the Kalash for Maa Lakshmi 🪷

* Take a clean Kalash and apply Haldi and Kumkum to it.
* Tie a sacred red thread (Mouli/Kalava) around its neck.
* Fill the Kalash with clean water.
* Add a coin, turmeric root, and a few grains of Akshata (unbroken rice) to the water.
* Place five mango leaves at the mouth of the Kalash and apply Haldi and Kumkum to the leaves.
* Place a coconut on top, preferably wrapped in a red cloth.
* Keep the Kalash near Maa Lakshmi’s Murti or image preferable on some unbroken rice 

🪔 BEGIN YOUR PUJA

3. Light a Diya

Begin by lighting a ghee or oil diya

दीपज्योतिः परब्रह्म दीपः सर्वतमोपहः ।
Dīpa-jyotiḥ parabrahma dīpaḥ sarva-tamōpahaḥ.

4. Worship Shri Ganesha

Offer flowers to Shri Ganesha and chant 3 times:

ॐ गं गणपतये नमः।
Aum Gam Ganpataye Namah 

5. Worship Maa Lakshmi

Offer flowers, kumkum, and akshata to Maa Lakshmi and the Kalash.

Chant:

ॐ श्रीं महालक्ष्म्यै नमः।
Aum Shreem Mahalakshmyai Namah

Pray for prosperity, nourishment, harmony, and abundance in all aspects of life.

6. Worship Your Dhan (Wealth)

Place coins, gold or silver ornaments, or other symbols of wealth near Maa Lakshmi.

Offer kumkum, akshata, and flowers.

This is an expression of gratitude for the resources we receive and a reminder to use wealth with wisdom, responsibility, and Dharma.

7. Chant Maa Lakshmi’s Names

Recite or listen to any one of the following:

* Sri Lakshmi Ashtottara Shatanamavali (108 Names)
* Sri Mahalakshmi Ashtakam
8. Worship Maa Saraswati

Offer flowers to Maa Saraswati and chant:

ॐ ऐं सरस्वत्यै नमः।

Om Aim Saraswatyai Namah

Place your books, notebooks, or musical instruments near the altar and offer flowers, kumkum, and akshata respectfully.

Seek Her blessings for knowledge, clarity, creativity, and wisdom.

9. Offer Dhoopam & Deepam

Offer incense (Dhoopam), followed by the light of a diya (Deepam), to the Deities.

10. Offer Naivedya

Offer freshly prepared sweets, fruits, or other sattvic food as Naivedya with gratitude.

11. Conclude with Aarti

Perform any Aarti you know, or simply offer a camphor (Karpur) Aarti.

Bow down and offer your gratitude to the Divine.

Shubh Deepavali 🪔

snippet.title: Eleições nos EUA: conheça os brasileiros eleitos deputados estaduais
snippet.description:
Quatro candidatos de origem brasileira foram eleitos para legislativos estaduais nos Estados Unidos, todos pelo Partido Democrata. Em Massachusetts, Priscila Souza, de Ipatinga (MG), conquistou o terceiro mandato consecutivo. Rita Mendes, de Conselheiro Pena (MG), e Dan Sena, de Timbaúba (PE), também foram reeleitos.
Na Flórida, Felipe Sousa-Lazaballet, nascido em Duque de Caxias (RJ), tornou-se o primeiro brasileiro eleito para o Legislativo estadual. Outros três candidatos brasileiros ainda aguardam o resultado da apuração. Em Massachusetts, Farley Santos e Lorena Betts disputam vagas. Já a carioca Elaine Marzolla concorre à Câmara dos Representantes de Nevada.

İmlie, Arvin’le ilgili gerçeklerin peşine düşer ve ona tuzak kurduğunu düşündüğü ailenin evine gizlice girer. Arvin hakkında yaptıkları konuşmayı kaydeder ve evden ayrılır. snippet.title: Village Style Paneer Pulao Recipe in Tamil 🔥 Maamiyaar vs Marumagal #shorts #tamilcooking #viral
snippet.description:
Paneer Pulao in pressure cooker – easy village style recipe in Tamil! 🍚🔥
Soft paneer, fluffy basmati rice, fresh mint and home-ground ginger garlic masala – ready in just 2 whistles.

A 1990s village kitchen, an old-style maamiyaar and a town marumagal with a new pressure cooker. Who wins – mann paanai or cooker? Watch till the end! 😍

🛒 Ingredients:
• Basmati rice – 1 cup (soaked 20 mins)
• Paneer – 200 g (thick cubes)
• Onion – 2 (thinly sliced)
• Tomato – 2
• Green chilli – 2
• Fresh ginger garlic paste – 1 tbsp
• Mint & coriander leaves – a handful
• Curd – 1 tbsp
• Garam masala – ½ tsp
• Cinnamon, cloves, cardamom, bay leaf
• Ghee + oil – 2 tbsp
• Lemon juice – ½ lemon
• Water – 1½ cups
• Salt – as needed

👩‍🍳 Cooking Tips:
✅ Fry paneer lightly in ghee and soak in warm salt water – stays super soft
✅ Slice onions thin and add a pinch of salt – browns faster
✅ Fresh ammi-ground ginger garlic gives the best aroma
✅ Lemon juice keeps rice grains separate
✅ 2 whistles + 10 minutes rest = perfect pulao

snippet.title: ‘Texas has fallen’: How Democrats turned Texas blue
snippet.description:
Republicans have suffered a historic loss in Texas as the state elects its first Democratic senator in over thirty years.

James Talarico compared his victory over Republican Ken Paxton, the state’s Attorney General and a firm ally of Donald Trump, to David and Goliath.

Elon Musk had also taken particular interest in the Texas race, spending over $200 million on the campaign - the largest single-state political investment ever.

In his victory speech, James Talarico said  “All the money in the world is no match for the people of Texas.” 

The Republican incumbent governor Greg Abbott was also defeated as Democrat Gina Hinojosa was elected as the state’s first Latina governor.
 
The Republican Party suffered wounds across the country as both the Senate and the House of Representatives fell out of the control of Donald Trump’s party, but ‘ruby red’ Texas is particularly bruising loss.
